title: LiteCode Provider Catalog
description: Providers and models known to LiteCode. This file is read once at startup; the Rust contract in src/provider_catalog is authoritative.

version.description: Structure version. Any other value is refused at startup.

models.description: Every selectable model. A model that is not listed here does not exist.

endpoint_kind.description: Wire protocol. Closed set: a new value needs a new codec.

modality.description: Declared input modality. It must be implemented by the endpoint_type codec, or the catalog is refused.

usage_patch.description: Named response repair. Every value here is implemented by a codec.

quirk.description: Named non-universal protocol behavior, implemented by the codec for the provider's endpoint_type.

reasoning_key.description: Field a Chat Completions replay writes reasoning back into.

tiers.description: Platform low/medium/high mapped onto the vendor's own effort literals, plus the optional literal that means thinking OFF. All three levels are required; a vendor with fewer levels writes the clamp explicitly (low = "high").

off.description: Literal sent for Thinking OFF (compaction). Omit for a vendor whose default is thinking off; write it ("none", "disabled") for a vendor whose default is thinking on.

low.description: Literal sent for the platform Low tier.

medium.description: Literal sent for the platform Medium tier.

high.description: Literal sent for the platform High tier.

summary.description: Vendor literal opting into reasoning summaries (OpenAI-family Responses hosts: auto / concise / detailed; they never expose raw reasoning and emit nothing unless asked). Absent = no summary is requested.

id.description: Stable id, unique in this file, matching [a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]*. Model references are "<id>/<model id>".

visible.description: Show in the Settings provider picker.

quirks.description: Opt into named vendor behaviors for this provider.

headers.description: Extra request headers. {{session_id}} is the only supported placeholder.

provider_id.description: Id of a provider in this file.

label.description: Display name; the wire id is used when omitted.

context_window_max.description: Upper bound used by context mode "max". Defaults to context_window.

tool_call.description: false marks the model as unusable for agents in the picker.

reasoning.description: Omit for a model that takes no reasoning control.

extra_body.description: Merged into the request body. Codec-owned keys are rejected.
